entities.name: PMID:25424361
observations: 2015 Cell Proliferation study of PRMT5 in dairy-goat embryonic fibroblast reprogramming.
PRMT5 overexpression with OCT3/4, SOX2, KLF4, and C-MYC increased alkaline-phosphatase-positive iPS-like colonies versus OSKM alone.
PRMT5 overexpression stimulated fibroblast proliferation and reduced p53, p21, and caspase-3; abstract describes these changes as enhancing reprogramming, but does not report a p53 rescue experiment.

entities.name: PRMT5
observations: Overexpression in dairy-goat embryonic fibroblasts together with OSKM increased AP-positive iPS-like colony counts in PMID:25424361.

entities.name: TP53
observations: The PMID:25424361 abstract reports lower p53 expression after PRMT5 overexpression during dairy-goat fibroblast reprogramming; causal mediation is not established by the abstract alone.

entities.name: PRMT5 goat iPSC effect
observations: In vitro PRMT5 overexpression with OSKM significantly increased AP-positive iPS-like colony number from dairy-goat embryonic fibroblasts versus OSKM alone; p53, p21, and caspase-3 were reduced.
